name: Psytrance (full-on / progressive)
description: Loud, bright, driving. Kick + rolling 16th bassline own 40-150 Hz, scooped low-mids, forward acid/lead presence, crisp wide top, rock-solid mono low end.
notes: Kick ~45-60 Hz fundamental, bass rolls on the off-16ths around 60-150 Hz: the 63/125 octaves carry the energy, deep sub (31 Hz) less than dubstep/hip-hop.
Low-mids (250-500) scooped so the kick-bass 'KBBB' pattern stays clean and punchy.
Brighter than a typical dance master: acid squelches, screaming leads, sharp hats and FX up top.
Mono below ~120 Hz (club systems), very wide 1-16 kHz for the psychedelic FX.
Masters are LOUD: around -6 to -7 LUFS integrated.
source: hand-tuned estimate from genre conventions (not measured from a track corpus)
